'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike French LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike French]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Mike Frach
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
